facts.business: Nectar Lifesciences Limited has historically been a global pharmaceutical company with a strong presence in the cephalosporin segment, particularly third and fourth-generation cephalosporins, and has sold its API and formulation business through a slump sale, entering the real estate sector via its wholly owned subsidiary Avensis Exports Private Limited.
key_risks: Weather-related risks impacting inflation and rural demand
Disruptions in global trade and capital flows
facts.related_party_note: The Company has a policy adopted for related party transactions. The Schedule of related party transactions during the year and balances at year end were obtained and read. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting wherein such related party transactions have been pre-approved prior by the Audit Committee were reviewed.
